triggers.name: account_monitoring_protect_profile
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER account_monitoring_protect_profile BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON public.profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION account_monitoring_protect_suspension()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_monitoring_protect_suspension()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Profiles table uses "status"
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'profiles' THEN

    IF OLD.status = 'suspended'
       AND NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspended'
       AND CURRENT_USER NOT IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin')
    THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Only authorized Staff actions may reactivate an account'
        USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;

  -- Caterers table uses "account_standing"
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'caterers' THEN

    IF OLD.account_standing = 'suspended'
       AND NEW.account_standing IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspended'
       AND CURRENT_USER NOT IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin')
    THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Only authorized Staff actions may restore caterer standing'
        USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;

  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE POLICY "Customers report missing pending refunds" ON public.refund_disputes AS PERMISSIVE FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (((EXISTS ( SELECT 1

  WHERE ((p.id = auth.uid()) AND (p.role = 'customer'::text)))) AND (customer_id = auth.uid()) AND (status = 'open'::text) AND (resolved_at IS NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM bookings b
  WHERE ((b.id = refund_disputes.booking_id) AND (b.customer_id = auth.uid()) AND (b.status = 'cancelled'::text) AND (b.refund_status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'overdue'::text, 'awaiting_customer_confirmation'::text])) AND (b.refund_amount > (0)::numeric) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM refund_transfer_submissions r
          WHERE (r.booking_id = b.id))))))));

triggers.name: trg_notify_refund_dispute_caterer_response
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_notify_refund_dispute_caterer_response AFTER UPDATE OF caterer_response, caterer_responded_at ON public.refund_disputes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION notify_refund_dispute_caterer_response()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_refund_dispute_caterer_response()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_customer_id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF NULLIF(BTRIM(NEW.caterer_response), '') IS NOT NULL
     AND NEW.caterer_response IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.caterer_response
     AND NEW.caterer_responded_at IS NOT NULL THEN

    SELECT b.customer_id INTO v_customer_id
    FROM public.bookings b
    WHERE b.id = NEW.booking_id
      AND b.customer_id = NEW.customer_id;

    IF v_customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      INSERT INTO public.notifications
        (user_id, title, message, type, booking_id, is_read)
      VALUES
        (v_customer_id,
         'Refund Dispute Update',
         'Your caterer has responded to your refund dispute. Open My Bookings to review the investigation update.',
         'refund_dispute_response',
         NEW.booking_id,
         false);
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

triggers.name: trg_notify_refund_dispute_created
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_notify_refund_dispute_created AFTER INSERT ON public.refund_disputes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION notify_refund_dispute_created()
triggers.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_refund_dispute_created()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_caterer_user_id uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT c.user_id INTO v_caterer_user_id
  FROM public.bookings b
  JOIN public.caterers c ON c.id = b.caterer_id
  WHERE b.id = NEW.booking_id
    AND b.customer_id = NEW.customer_id
    AND b.status = 'cancelled'
    AND COALESCE(b.refund_amount, 0) > 0;

  IF v_caterer_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.notifications
      (user_id, title, message, type, booking_id, is_read)
    VALUES
      (v_caterer_user_id,
       'New Refund Dispute',
       'A customer reported an issue with a refund. Open Bookings to review the dispute.',
       'refund_dispute_opened',
       NEW.booking_id,
       false);
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_refund_staff()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT
    auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.profiles p
      WHERE p.id = auth.uid()
        AND p.role IN ('staff', 'admin')
    );
$function$
